biography_english:
A Xenobian of unknown origin who once led the Mages Regiment of the Kingdom of New Xenobia. He came to Valeria to recover the sword Brynhildr at the behest of King Tristan of Xenobia.
  While attempting to seal the Chaos Gate beneath the Hanging Gardens he was imprisoned within it. He was rescued when {hero} opened the Chaos Gate in the Palace of the Dead.
biography_spanish:
Xenobiano de origen desconocido que lidero el Regimiento de Magos del Reino de Nueva Xenobia. Vino a Valeria a recuperar la espada Brynhildr por orden del rey Tristan de Xenobia.     
  Al intentar sellar la Puerta del Caos bajo los Jardines Colgantes quedo atrapado en ella. Fue rescatado cuando {hero} abrio la Puerta del Caos en el Palacio de los Muertos.

biography_english:
A Xenobian of unknown origin who once led the Mages Regiment of the Kingdom of New Xenobia. He came to Valeria to recover the sword Brynhildr at the behest of King Tristan of Xenobia.
  After being grievously wounded during the Bakram invasion of Rhime, he recuperated at Almorica. He saved {hero} when the Chaos Gate collapsed during a momentous battle at the Hanging Gardens, but was himself trapped. It is not known if he survived.

biography_english:
A Xenobian from the city of Peshaval in Charlom who once captained the Beast Legion of the Kingdom of New Xenobia.
  Like the Holy Knight Lanselot, he was banished from Xenobia for misconduct. He appears young in years, as winged folk live to thrice the age of men.
biography_spanish:
Xenobiano de la ciudad de Peshaval en Charlom que capitaneo la Legion de Bestias del Reino de Nueva Xenobia.      
  Como el caballero sagrado Lanselot, fue expulsado de Xenobia por mala conducta. Aparenta ser joven, pues los alados viven el triple que los hombres.

biography_english:
A Xenobian from the city of Peshaval in Charlom who once captained the Beast Legion of the Kingdom of New Xenobia.
  Like the Holy Knight Lanselot, he was banished from Xenobia for misconduct. He joined the Walister Resistance after aiding {hero} in freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. Since then he has accompanied {hero}.
  He appears young in years, as winged folk live to thrice the age of men.
